description: List the buyer's settlement cycles (the tab): each cycle's status (open, closed, capturing, captured, settled, …), exposure limit, authorised, accrued and captured amounts in minor units, and capture_due_at, the end of the review window. funding is card_hold or prepaid; a prepaid cycle's remaining_pence is its unspent balance. Filter by status or currency; paginate with cursor. Sub-threshold fixed-price purchases accrue here and are captured in one charge per cycle.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous page.
